craft_notes: Sthāyin: marvel at effortless lordship. Device: question→dash (straining asked, lordship lands). Rejected: 'brine' for 'milk-sea' — killed: milk is the Vṛtti's śleṣa (sweetness); kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: For gem and sweet immortal prize, what gods unstrained —
that milk-sea lordship, thine alone, inborn, O Bounteous.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śrīratnāmṛtalābhāya kliṣṭaṃ yatra na kaiḥ suraiḥ tat kṣīrodadam aiśvaryaṃ tavaiva sahajaṃ vibho

reads_against.argmap: For Śrī-jewel-nectar gain, labored where not by which gods?; That milk-ocean lordship: yours alone, natural, O Lord. → Gods labored for nectar elsewhere; milk-ocean lordship is yours naturally.
c1_essence: Milk-sea fortune natural to the Lord alone; the blossomer gives bliss in being and non-being.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti with prasāda (grace received and returned)
